# Asset and dependency ledger

Every asset shipped with the game must be listed here. Rule: original work or a verified free licence only.

## Generated by this project (original work)

| Asset | Path | Made by | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Characters | `public/assets/characters/*.glb` | `tools/blender/build_characters.py` | Procedural Blender models and baked textures. No third-party meshes or images. |
| Vehicles | `public/assets/vehicles/*.glb` | `tools/blender/build_vehicles.py` | Includes original generated rickshaw and truck art. No brands. |
| Street props | `public/assets/props/*.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. |
| Pedal van with jute sacks | `public/assets/props/van_cart.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Original geometry. |
| Sack pile on a pallet | `public/assets/props/sack_pile.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Original geometry. |
| Mobile-recharge kiosk | `public/assets/props/flexi_kiosk.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. No text, brands or logos; plain painted fascia. |
| Clothes hawker's stall | `public/assets/props/clothes_rack.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Original plaids; no brands. |
| Shoe stall with umbrella | `public/assets/props/shoe_stall.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Unbranded shoes and sandals. |
| Tin shed | `public/assets/props/tin_shed.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Corrugation is real geometry. |
| Bamboo scaffold panel | `public/assets/props/scaffold_bamboo.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Thin geometry, no alpha textures. |
| Brick pile | `public/assets/props/brick_pile.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Original geometry. |
| Tin site hoarding | `public/assets/props/tin_hoarding.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Corrugation is real geometry. No site signage. |
| Paper bunting | `public/assets/props/bunting.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Plain coloured pennants, no text. |
| Plant nursery row | `public/assets/props/plant_nursery.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Leaves are opaque geometry. |
| Overhead cable bundle | `public/assets/props/cable_bundle.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Procedural, baked. Original geometry. |
| Landmarks | `public/assets/landmarks/*.glb` | `tools/blender/build_props.py` | Original approximations, not surveyed or copied models. The metro station and mosque are generic designs. |
| Shop interiors | `public/assets/textures/shops.webp` | `tools/textures/build_shops.py` | Painted from code. No text, brands or logos. |
| Far vehicle models | `public/assets/vehicles/*_lod1.glb` | `tools/blender/build_vehicle_lods.py` | Reduced from this project's own vehicles. |
| Far character models | `public/assets/characters/*_lod1.glb` | `tools/blender/build_lods.py` | Reduced from this project's own characters. |
| Loading screen picture | `public/assets/ui/loading.webp` | Captured from the game | A screenshot of this project's own world. |
| Sky panoramas | `public/assets/sky/*` | `tools/blender/build_sky.py` | Rendered from Blender's sky model and procedural clouds. |
| Surface textures | `public/assets/textures/*` | `tools/textures/build_textures.py` | Generated with numpy and Pillow. No photos. |
| Sound | none shipped | `src/audio/audio.ts` | Synthesised live with Web Audio. |
| Bangla voice | browser's speech synthesis | The player's own browser | Nothing shipped. Only the game's own lines are spoken, by a voice the browser provides. |
| Bangla signage | runtime canvas | `src/world/signs.ts` | Original generic names. Phone numbers are all zeros. No real shops or brands. |

Concept boards in `Guide Docs/character_and_asset_reference_sheets/` were used as art direction only and are not shipped.

## Still to verify

- Road names other than Begum Rokeya Sarani are plausible local names placed by hand, not checked against a map.
- All Bangla text should be reviewed by a native speaker. It was written and proofread by the AI developer.
- The traffic police reflective vest and cap are an artistic choice; no source confirmed the exact traffic uniform.
